title: Rain is such a lonesome s - JAY MCSHANN

lines.l: Well, the sun should be shining, but the rain keeps coming down
When you're waiting for your baby, rain is such a lonesome sound
I've got a fine little girl
She weighs just about a hundred and two
Yes, I've got a fine little girl
And she weighs about a hundred and two
Well, she's mean and evil sometimes
But so am I, so are you
Like a fool I'll let her leave me
One bright sunshiny day
Yes, like a fool I'll let her leave me
One bright and sunny, shiny day
Well, it's been nothing but stormy weather
Ever since she went away
When I woke up this morning
Looked through my windowpane
Well, I woke up this morning
And I looked through my winter pain
Well, I was thinking about my baby
But all I could see was the rain
The sun should be shining
But the rain keeps coming on down
Well, the sun should be shining
But the rain keeps coming down
When you're waiting for your baby
Rain is such a lonesome sound
